members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Manage organization member profiles
members.addFirst: Add the first member manually or import a CSV to give the tenant a working directory.
members.requiredColumns: Required columns: member_code, first_name, last_name. Optional: display_name, email, phone, status.
members.germanAddressHelp: German address format: street, number, 5-digit postal code, and city.
members.generatedEmailHelp: A unique @combis.org address is assigned automatically when the member is created.
members.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, member code, or email…
members.individualContributionDescriptio: An initial €60 balance will be created in finance.
members.familyContributionDescription: An initial €100 balance will be created in finance.
members.memberCodeAuto: The member code is generated automatically from the name, the COMBIS suffix, and a unique number.
members.memberCodeAutoReview: Assigned automatically when the member is saved
members.phoneHelp: Select the country, then enter the number without its international calling code. Germany (+49) is preselected.
members.phoneFormatRequired: The login phone number must use international format, for example +49 123 456789.
members.reviewSubmissionHelp: Carefully review this information before permanently creating the member.
members.directAccessHelp: The member must replace this password at first sign-in.
members.loginIdentifierHelp: Use 3 to 64 letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, or underscores.
members.defaultTemporaryPasswordHelp: Pre-filled with CombisPass#; change it if necessary before creating the member.
members.accountContactRequired: Provide at least an email address, an international phone number, or a login identifier.
members.passwordMismatch: The two temporary passwords do not match.
